==Background==
{{Quote|Hyperflip Inspired!!<br><br>
A high-energy digital anthem exploring our hyperconnected reality through glitchy electronic beats and Hatsune Miku's captivating vocals. This track dives deep into the paradox of modern digital life - where we're more connected yet more isolated than ever.<br><br>
"Internet Junk Junkie" captures the chaotic essence of internet culture through pulsating electronic production and thought-provoking lyrics. From endless scrolling to dopamine-driven notifications, this track transforms digital exhaustion into an explosive musical experience.|Author's comment}}
"'''Internet Junk Junkie'''" is an original song by Capchii featuring Hatsune Miku. It was one of two winners in the thirtieth ProSEKA Next Song Contest for the mobile game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}'', with this contest having no set theme.

==Lyrics==
<poem style="margin-left:1em;">
Wake with screen glow, heartbeats blow
Crawling through the noise already know
Plastic dreams are in pixel streams
Selling lies me in dopamine beams

Notifications like sirens in night
Dry eyes open but lost my sight
Identity is "@username"
Internet Junk Junkie!!

Laughing in chat, but bored in my code.
Show the emotion with the memes that I've never seen it
By biting bytes, I lose my real taste
Chasing clout like it's oxygen right now!

To be burst, To be blast
Living fast in a digital bygone
To be worst, To be vast
Drifting deep in a broadband trance
To be burst, To be blast
Signal strong, but the soul won't last
To be first, To be last
I’ll be glitches in the system of the world

Umm… Just one more scroll, Just one more video…
Well… Whaat's!?
Why my battery dying again??

Wake with screen glow, heartbeats blow
Crawling through the noise already know
Plastic dreams are in pixel streams
Selling lies me in dopamine beams

Notifications like sirens in night
Dry eyes open but lost my sight
Identity is "@username"
I’m wired tightly web of threads

To be burst, To be blast
Living fast in a digital bygone
To be worst, To be vast
Drifting deep in a broadband trance
To be burst, To be blast
Signal strong, but the soul won’t last
To be first, To be last
I'll be glitches in the system of the world
</poem>

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
This song was featured on the following albums:
* ''Internet Junk Junkie (single)''
* ''We're Junk Junkies!!'' (Original & DJ Genki Remix)

===Video games===
This song was featured in the video game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}''.
